summary: The E-Rate program remains a critical component of the nation's educational infrastructure. School districts rely on E-Rate support to provide and maintain the broadband connectivity and network services necessary for teaching and learning, school operations, student safety, cybersecurity, and communication with families. Any reduction or elimination of E-Rate funding would have a significant financial impact on school districts at a time when K-12 education is facing increasing fiscal constrain
